subject: Travel plan for Tuesday visit
text: I am writing because the client site visit next Tuesday has to happen by morning, and we need to settle the travel route tonight. Since the train schedule changes during peak hours, I checked the 7:15 connection first, but it arrives too close to the 9:00 checkpoint, so we would have no buffer if anything slips. I think the 6:40 bus is the safer choice, especially if we bring the printed materials and the backup tablet. If we take the bus, we can meet at the east end of the apartment block, near the mailboxes, which keeps us away from the roadworks on the side street. I can drive if the weather turns, though the office lot fills early, so parking may be awkward. My neighbor says the side entrance near the coffee kiosk sometimes opens late, but I would not rely on that. Please confirm tonight whether you want the bus, the train, or my car. If the deadline moves later, we can simplify, but until then we should assume the original timing. I will book seats once I have your reply, and if anything blocks me before noon, I will leave a note at your usual mailbox spot before leaving.
